name: Newt

review.observation: Full original: smooth dark amphibian skin, bright orange spotted belly, laterally flattened continuous tail and four short visible limbs. No scales, external ears or larval gills. Near toe counts look reduced/merged and require anatomical review; tail taper is fairly abrupt but connected. Broad margins. Never an all-visible anatomy admission.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
